info.title: 101 Challenge HTTP API
info.description: Documentation of the current local tracker. Cookie-authenticated browser API plus OAuth callbacks, signed Discord ingress and service health. JSON browser responses use private, no-store caching. Custom domain validation remains authoritative; no new endpoints are introduced by this document.

post.description: Anonymous actions: signup, login, recover, verify, reset, verify_recovery_email. All other actions require the session cookie and x-csrf-token. add_email, unlink, request_erasure and recovery_email also require authentication within the last ten minutes. Usernames are trimmed and lowercased; email addresses are lowercased. Payload limit: 2 MiB. Avatar accepts null or a PNG/JPEG/WebP base64 data URL (max 400000 characters); decoding is limited to 16 million pixels and output is sanitized WebP up to 256×256. Accepted signup/recovery does not disclose whether an address exists. Login and restore_account set session cookies; logout, unlink, reset and request_erasure clear them.

post.description: Payload limit: 2 MiB. Identity, reporting date for SubmitReport, timestamps, mode and seeds are server-owned. Ownership and optimistic versions are checked by core. Administrator commands require admin access; IssueCorrectionGrant and RevokeCorrectionGrant additionally require authentication within ten minutes. Replays reauthorize and reload the resource; reuse the key only for the same logical command.

post.description: Discord wire envelope, not a browser command endpoint. Requires Ed25519 signature of timestamp + raw body and timestamp within five minutes; maximum body 65536 bytes. PING returns type 1. Guild replies are private, slow work defers with type 5, and modals use type 9. Domain failures can be private type 4 messages with HTTP 200. Provider-specific fields are extensible; this document describes the supported envelope rather than the entire Discord protocol.

Usernames are trimmed and lowercased; email addresses are lowercased.

TrackerCommand.description: Strict command objects; server checks authorization, lifecycle, ownership and custom refinements. Milestone goalIndex must reference the submitted goal list; goalValues and milestoneAchievements must use distinct IDs. Timezones must be valid IANA names. Decimal strings have at most 18 total digits and 6 fractional digits; supplied targets must be positive.

Error400.description: VALIDATION: invalid payload, cursor or idempotency key.

Error401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: missing, expired or revoked proof.

Error403.description: FORBIDDEN: origin, CSRF, recent authentication or authorization check failed.

Error409.description: Domain or optimistic version conflict; see error code.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Unexpected service failure; private details omitted.
